## TL;DR
Hoardkeeper knows what is in your chests, and this is its first release.

- Scan the containers around you without a single screen popping up.
- Find any item with `/hoard search` or by holding it and pressing V.
- Tooltips and a crouch card show what your storage holds.
- Singleplayer: put your inventory away into the chests that already hold it.
- Servers: scanning is off until you `/hoard allow` it; search works anyway.

---

Hoardkeeper is what storage-scanner became once it stopped depending on one group's web server:
the same scanner, search, tooltips and map, with no network code at all.

### Since the test build

The mod has an icon now, in Mod Menu and on Modrinth. Nothing else changed for players.

### Coming from storage-scanner

On first start, `config/storage-scanner.json` and the `storage-scanner/` folder carry over, so
everything you measured is still there. Remove the storage-scanner jar, because the two refuse to
start together. The command is now `/hoard`.

### What is new since storage-scanner

- **Scanning needs permission on servers.** Many servers forbid automatic container opening, so
  the scanner only acts in singleplayer and on servers you allowed with `/hoard allow`. Everywhere
  else it records the containers you open by hand, so search and tooltips still work.
- **Finished scans clean up after themselves** once the map holds them (`keepSessions` keeps them).
- **Fixed:** an item you picked up in the moment a container was being scanned could go missing on
  your client until you relogged.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Java 25+
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API
